eyebrow.zh: 本地 · 单命令 · 随包传播 · 可核验
eyebrow.en: Local · One command · Travels with the model · Verifiable

headline.zh:
手写的部署配置
随模型一起传播
headline.en:
Hand-written serving configs
now travel with the model

sub.zh: ggufbill 读出模型文件的身份，把你验证过的部署配置写成一份清单，随模型文件跨机器、跨重建传播。
sub.en: ggufbill reads the model file's identity and writes your verified serving config into a manifest that travels with the model across machines and rebuilds.

body.zh: 一份清单随模型文件一起走，换机器、重装环境都不用手抄第二遍——已验证的部署配置原样跟着模型走。
body.en: One manifest travels with the model file, so a new machine or a fresh install never costs you a re-typed config — your verified deployment rides along as-is.

title.zh: 一份文件，记全整个部署
title.en: One file for the whole deployment

body.zh: 上下文长度、显存、GPU 拓扑、已知坑——你验证过的每一项配置都收进同一份清单，不再散落在帖子和便签里。
body.en: Context length, VRAM, GPU topology, known quirks — every setting you verified lands in one manifest, instead of scattered across posts and sticky notes.

chips: › 上下文 · 显存 · GPU 拓扑

title.zh: 每个盒子都有可核验的凭证
title.en: Every box has a verifiable record

body.zh: 责任人、采购单号、等保级别在生成时就写进清单——审计方拿到的是每个盒子一份、对得上号的部署凭证，不用再翻帖子反推。
body.en: Operator, procurement ref, and 等保 level are written into the manifest at emit time — auditors get a deployment record for each box that actually matches, no more reverse-engineering posts.

title.zh: 本地一条命令，永久免费

body.zh: 一条命令装好，不联网注册、数据不出门；工具与清单格式永久 MIT 免费，核心动作永不设墙。
body.en: One command installs it — no sign-up, no network round-trip, your data never leaves the box; the tool and format are MIT free forever, and the core act is never gated.

headline.zh: 现在就给你的模型配一份清单
headline.en: Give your model a manifest today

sub.zh: 一条命令，让每个 GGUF 部署可复现、可核验。开源、MIT、本地优先。
sub.en: One command makes every GGUF deployment reproducible and verifiable. Open source, MIT, local-first.

tag.zh: 随 GGUF 传播的部署清单，MIT 免费
tag.en: The deployment manifest that travels with your GGUF — MIT free
